2.new: Northwest Maple Ridge is a name for an MLS® sub-area, and the City of Maple Ridge does not publish a boundary for it. The neighbourhoods on the City’s list are Ruskin, Albion/Kanaka, Whonnock, Thornhill, Port Haney, Yennadon, Silver Valley, Town Centre, Port Hammond and Webster’s Corners, and none of them is a northwest area.

28.new: Routes 743 and 701 have timetables effective January 1, 2024, route 744 June 8, 2026 and route 791 April 21, 2025. Check the current timetable, because a TransLink news post dated August 24, 2026 says route 701 gets service improvements from September 7, 2026.

105.new: Taken from MLS sales data rather than an official source: for detached houses sold July 1 through October 8, 2026, the median lot size was 7,201 sq ft, calculated from the 9 sales that had a recorded lot size.

124.old: The Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan was adopted on January 27, 2026 as Official Community Plan Amending Bylaw No. 7781-2021. It covers Lougheed Highway from Maple Meadows Way to 221 Street, along the south edge of this area.
124.new: On January 27, 2026 the Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan was formally adopted via Official Community Plan Amending Bylaw No. 7781-2021. The plan takes in the stretch of Lougheed Highway between Maple Meadows Way and 221 Street, along the south edge of this area.

128.new: Floodplain maps for the Fraser and Alouette rivers are published by the City, which describes a floodplain map as showing the area expected to flood about once every 200 years on average.

130.old: TransLink’s Langley–Haney Place Bus Rapid Transit line would run 22 km with 13 stations and service every 10 minutes at peak. TransLink says it is in detailed planning with preliminary funding through the 2025 Investment Plan, and that more funding is needed to deliver it.
130.new: Under TransLink’s plan, Langley–Haney Place Bus Rapid Transit would cover 22 km and have 13 stations, with peak service every 10 minutes. TransLink says the line remains in detailed planning. Through the 2025 Investment Plan it has preliminary funding, and TransLink says more is needed to deliver it.
